# Minimum Gap

Narrowest gap between facing walls of the part, which can fuse shut as it prints.

<figure markdown="span">
![Minimum Gap: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-print-gap-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Minimum Gap: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-print-gap-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Narrowest gap between facing walls, which can fuse shut.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | High |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.3 mm | Aim for: Published, [AMF (University of Zurich)](../../citations/bibliography.md#amf-uzh "0.5 mm clearance"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-fdm)<br>At least: Engineering judgement, [Sovol](../../citations/bibliography.md#sovol-fdm "About the tightest print-in-place gap: 0.2 to 0.3 mm a side (Sovol)") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2 and 3: 0.5 mm clearance")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.4 mm clearance") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.0 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "1 mm recommended gap between walls")<br>At least: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "0.5 mm minimum gap between walls") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Narrow gap (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Extruded lines bulge into a gap this narrow, so its sides may touch and stick. Widen it to at least `{target}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Gap may fuse shut (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. The two sides will likely print as one. Widen it to at least `{target}`, or print the parts separately.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Narrow gap (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Resin left in a narrow gap cures and bridges it. Widen it to at least `{target}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Gap may fuse shut (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Its sides will likely fuse. Widen it to at least `{target}`.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Narrow gap (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Powder in a narrow gap fuses to its sides and is hard to clear. Widen it to at least `{target}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Gap may fuse shut (`{measured}`): the gap between `{faces}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Heat from the laser will likely fuse it. Widen it to at least `{target}`.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{faces}` | The two faces, such as "Face8 and Face10" |
